instruction: Supply Air Duct System Use the opened Bonsai IFC authoring environment to create a new metric IFC4 supply air duct system from a blank model. Save the completed model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. The hierarchy must include one project, one site, one building, and one storey named Level 00. Model exactly three IfcDuctSegment entities, two IfcDuctFitting entities, two IfcAirTerminal entities, one IfcDistributionSystem, and one IfcRelAssignsToGroup relationship. Do not include spaces, walls, slabs, doors, windows, proxies, furniture, roofs, columns, beams, or stairs, and keep every IfcRoot GlobalId unique. Name the distribution system Supply Air and assign exactly these seven products to it: Main Segment, Branch Spine, Riser Segment, Transition, Bend, Terminal East, and Terminal North. The duct segments must be Main Segment at 2.40 m by 0.40 m by 0.30 m, Branch Spine at 1.80 m by 0.35 m by 0.25 m, and Riser Segment at 1.80 m by 0.30 m by 0.25 m, with each dimension accepted in any axis order. The duct fittings must be Transition at 0.60 m by 0.45 m by 0.35 m and Bend at 0.50 m by 0.35 m by 0.35 m. Terminal East and Terminal North must each be 0.45 m by 0.45 m by 0.20 m. Spatially assign all duct segments, fittings, and terminals to Level 00. Other representation details may vary. [Software] Bonsai workflows are used together with Blender; start Blender with `blender` (adjust path if needed).
